newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Most Saudi riyal deposits rise, spot riyal eases.
newsitem.headline: Most Saudi riyal deposits rise, spot riyal eases.

text.p: In a liquid market, the spot Saudi riyal eased fractionally on the dollar this week but most riyal interbank deposits rose by between 1/16 and 1/8, dealers in the kingdom said on Wednesday.
The riyal was at 3.7504/06 from 3.7503/05 last week.
"Liquidity is very high in the market," said one Riyadh dealer said. Activity focused on short dates with spot-next and one-week funds put at 5-5/16, 3/16 percent, traders said.
One-month interbank funds were at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months 5-11/16, 9/16 and six months 5-13/16, 11/16. One-year funds were 6-1/8, six or 1/16 point higher at some banks.
